_doc: c3's declaration of how the Containers page groups containers by PROJECT (owner request 2026-11-04). `code` is the project's code in the fleet registry (git-repos-master 0_registry/projects-repos.json). A container belongs to the first project whose `folder_prefix` (its cloudy-u-containers folder, containers-declared.json `dir`) or `name_prefix` matches it, else to `default`. The container's own build.json carries no project field, so this file is the mapping. The page strip is declared in build.json (ui.sections[containers]); a project listed there with no match here shows an empty page, honestly.
